item.name: 03-4 Burst publish N concurrent RideCompletedV1 (same trip and PaymentKey)

request.description: [ADDED] Carrier request: the pre-request fires pf_cc_burst (default 10) publishes in parallel with pm.sendRequest. Expected PaymentService log: [TRANSIENT] Concurrency conflict processing payment for trip ... followed by a successful retry.

exec: // ===== [ADDED] DbUpdateConcurrencyException test (concurrent RideCompletedV1, same trip/PaymentKey) - BEGIN =====
// Fire N RideCompletedV1 at the same time: different EventId (so the inbox does not de-duplicate),
// same trip / PaymentKey / parameters (so no IdempotencyConflict). The consumers race on the same Payment row.
auth: { type: 'basic', basic: [{ key: 'username', value: cv('rabbit_user') }, { key: 'password', value: cv('rabbit_pass') }] },
try { routed = !err && res.code === 200 && res.json().routed === true; } catch (e) { routed = false; }
results.push({ ok: routed, code: res ? res.code : null });
// ===== [ADDED] DbUpdateConcurrencyException test (concurrent RideCompletedV1, same trip/PaymentKey) - BEGIN =====
pm.expect(results.filter(r => !r.ok), 'some publishes failed or were not routed').to.be.empty;

.map(m => { try { return JSON.parse(m.payload); } catch (e) { return null; } })

pm.expect(count, missing.length + ' of ' + ids.length + ' RideCompletedV1 produced no PaymentSettledV1/PaymentFailedV1 (still retrying, or moved to *_error). See PaymentService logs.').to.be.below(30);
